title: Dehydrate fruit and vegetables
summary: Control preparation, temperature, dryness and conditioning for stable dried food.
steps: Use a current tested method for the exact fruit or vegetable, including any pretreatment.
Cut pieces uniformly and arrange in a single uncrowded layer.
Maintain the specified dehydrator temperature and airflow; sun drying is not safe or suitable for every food or climate.
Test the stated final texture after cooling, not while food is still warm.
Condition and package as the method directs; inspect jars for condensation and return inadequately dried food to the dehydrator promptly.
